title: CONCATENATEX joins with the delimiter in the order of the sort expression
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CONCATENATEX ( Product, Product[Product], ", ", Product[Price], DESC ) )

source.quote: Any DAX expression where the result value is used to sort the concatenated values in the output string.
source.supports: the fourth argument sorts, the fifth gives the direction

source.quote: All the expressions are concatenated using the separator provided as third argument.

derivation: Prices: Bike 100, Helmet 20, Lock 10, Scooter 50. Descending by price: Bike, Scooter, Helmet, Lock, joined with ", ".
